title: A CA's clients, at a glance
caption: For CAs in India: how ScoreMyBiz helps you look after your clients. Part 1: your portfolio, scores, check-ins and drafts.
linkedin_text: For CAs in India. A free ScoreMyBiz CA account gives a code; clients who join with it appear in your portfolio with their score, its trend and what stands out. See who needs a call this week, check in on WhatsApp in one tap, get an email draft in your own voice from this month's numbers, download a client's book as a PDF or CSV, and share your own card on WhatsApp. A client appears only after linking and agreeing.
